title: Permutation associated to a perfect matching
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let a perfect matching be given on the complete graph with vertex set of size $2m$. Its partner permutation, viewed as a permutation of the vertices, has cycle type consisting of exactly $m$ cycles, each of length $2$.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching on the complete graph with vertex set of size $2m$
